projects.name: 00 Series Overview
projects.summary: Series hub for the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' workshop series (5 sessions): overview, format conventions, session links, open questions.

projects.name: ACM Fall 2026 Workshops
projects.summary: ACM Fall 2026 workshop series: workshops + team meetings Wednesdays 1 PM, first workshop Sep 2 (LinkedIn-Resume), NSDC Python collab Sep 23, SCE Homelab collab mid-Oct, Intro to Agentic AI series Oct 7–Dec 2 (outlines drafted 10-09).

projects.name: CRT Lab
projects.summary: Build a local-first browser workstation that routes generated signals, media, web pages, and user-owned ROMs through an adjustable CRT display or oscilloscope.

projects.name: EchoSphere
projects.summary: EchoSphere Physical AI Robot — Ayush leads SJSU ACM Robotics & Hardware team (6 members: hardware/software/electronics) in a 12-week build with IPMD (Min Lee) for EchoAi's Kickstarter demo. Kickoff Sep 7, 2026. Company meeting Sep 1: Kickstarter confirmed, $300–500 budget ask, EchoAI API still pending.

projects.name: Facebook Marketplace MCP
projects.summary: Facebook Marketplace MCP server exposing search + listing-detail tools to Hermes via a burner-account Chrome profile, live as of 2026-09-18, consumed interactively by the Marketplace Navigator bot and by two monitor-mode sweeps (wishlist roundup + hourly %-off steal sweep).

projects.name: G14 Omarchy
projects.summary: G14 Omarchy workstream — diagnose the dGPU/GPU state under Hyprland and grow the Omarchy partition to ~120 GB.

projects.name: Homelab
projects.summary: Plan the Lenovo ThinkStation P520 homelab for local AI and self-hosted services.

projects.name: Homelab Service Ideas — 2026-09-17 Swarm
projects.summary: Swarm research (7 agents + 3,172 r/selfhosted comments) on self-hosted services for the P520: tiered add-list, measured disk/RAM limits, verified skip-list; nothing deployed yet.

projects.name: Intro to Homelab Workshop
projects.summary: Intro to Homelab workshop outline (ACM x SCE, Fall 2026) — hardware ladder, what you actually learn, platform and network choices, services worth running, the presenter's own P520 layout as the worked example, SRE career mapping, and the SCE cloud bridge.

projects.name: Obsidian RAG Assistant
projects.summary: Build a private AI second brain that retrieves, cites, organizes, and eventually updates Ayush's Obsidian knowledge safely.

projects.name: Omarchy Tablet Mode
projects.summary: Omarchy tablet mode — touch-first UX and automatic posture switching for 2-in-1 convertibles (Chuwi Minibook X), gaming tablets (ROG Flow Z13), and pure tablets; demo-ready for the Omarchy SF meetup 2026-09-30.

projects.name: Personal Website
projects.summary: Create Ayumad.me as a personal operating system combining projects, interests, notes, media, and playful interactive presentation.

projects.name: RetroPie CRT Setup
projects.summary: Configure RetroPie on the Raspberry Pi 4 so games play on the Sony WEGA KV-20FS12 CRT with a drop-in ROM folder, plus Kodi so videos in a media folder are playable — best possible CRT experience.

projects.name: Vault
projects.summary: Refactor the vault into a skills-first, self-managing, archive-free knowledge base — audit done, execution in progress.

projects.name: Workshop 1 — The Landscape
projects.summary: Workshop 1 of the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' series — the landscape: what models, agents, and harnesses are, how we got here, the models in use (Oct 2026), benchmarks, the wider stack (providers, routers, runtimes, environments), and the honest list of things to be aware of.

projects.name: Workshop 2 — Using AI Well
projects.summary: Workshop 2 of the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' series — using AI well: context management, choosing the right model, effort levels, working modes (ask / plan / agent / debug / goal), and the full working loop.

projects.name: Workshop 3 — Expansion Brief (for Antigravity)
projects.summary: Working context dump for expanding Workshop 3 (Local and Personal AI) — audit of gaps, verified setup facts, anecdote bank, and slide numbers, written to be fed into Antigravity for outline cleanup + slide generation.

projects.name: Workshop 3 — Local and Personal AI
projects.summary: Workshop 3 of the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' series — local and personal AI: what personal agents (Hermes, Muse, Dots) are for, why local models matter, the hardware that runs them, and how to start.

projects.name: Workshop 4 — MCP 101
projects.summary: Workshop 4 of the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' series — MCP 101, co-presented with an industry guest: what MCP is, the pieces, a one-file build that takes half the session, security, and the production view.

projects.name: Workshop 5 — Vibecoding
projects.summary: Workshop 5 of the ACM Fall 2026 'Intro to Agentic AI' series — vibecoding: what it is, where it works, the build loop, an in-room ship-a-page activity, guardrails, and how to get good at it.

projects.name: YouTube Data Deep Dive
projects.summary: Pull Ayush's personal YouTube data (watch history, saved, liked, subscriptions, playlists) and build a profile of what it says about him. Public findings done; 3 routes to private data (Takeout / CDP cookies / manual sign-in).

projects.name: Audio Hub
projects.summary: Audio Hub: one web app bundling a by-ear EQ trainer (sweep a sine, mark peaks/dips, export an 8-band PEQ), a feed of recent audio articles, and a library of articles explaining audio terms.

projects.name: Electronics Workbench
projects.summary: Set up a practical electronics and creative-technology workbench for the sister's room.

projects.name: Loadout Browser
projects.summary: Vibe-coded website for looking through the Loadout — built with the anatomy skill (interactive isometric figures) and a Claude-driven plan; target end of Oct 2026.

projects.name: P520 GPU Passthrough Runbook
projects.summary: P520 GPU passthrough runbook + always-accessible OS VM plan (Ubuntu + Fedora)

projects.name: School VM Runbook
projects.summary: Runbook for school-vm (P520 vmid 201): the on-demand Ubuntu 24.04 Linux box holding CMPE 131/142/148 coursework. Access, lifecycle, class-work recipes, snapshots/restore, and verified state.

projects.name: Social Bookmark Sync
projects.summary: Auto-sync Reddit saves, X bookmarks (and TikTok favorites later) into Hermes + Obsidian vault. Shared ingest pipeline, script-first, zero-token when idle. Deferred — build routes researched.

projects.name: Study Harness
projects.summary: Idea: an agent harness built around learning — mastery tracking, Socratic drilling, spaced repetition, and course-aware study plans.

projects.name: Voice Assistant
projects.summary: Deferred local-first voice interface to Hermes using Raspberry Pi audio hardware and Home Assistant.

projects.name: Voice Memo Vault
projects.summary: Voice Memo Vault: a local-first, cross-platform voice memo app that auto-labels conversations, lets you append to an existing thread, and exposes the whole store as agent-readable data for Hermes.

projects.name: Album Ranking App
projects.summary: Standalone Beli-style social music app built off the ayumad.me rate-album / Taste Elo feature — album Elo ratings, ranked leaderboards, genre overviews, a constant Spotify-Wrapped-like listening dashboard, and social album recommendations. Web + mobile. Backburnered 2026-10-12 (was: start by end of Aug 2026).
